countingNotes: A block with a term meaning is a definition; causes, proposed solutions, actor-role lists, model descriptions and interface notes are recorded separately.
EN and RU copies represent one bilingual occurrence. Five identical tourism cards and repeated summaries are deduplicated by canonical concept id.
A compound glossary entry is one grouped entry; its atomic named terms are separately listed. Synonyms such as focus/hypocentre count as one term.
Grouped mock comparisons stay three review groups. Spearman is a repeated concept already present in fieldwork.
Direct figure means drawn geometry or arrows explain the named concept. Nearby figures, HTML comparison cards and tables do not count as direct figures.
Exact sources now come from current public data, superseding preliminary source/visual mappings in coverage-legacy.json and coverage-tectonics.json.

evidenceLimits.detail: No claim that all Russian definitions were independently established from Russian-language texts. Exact direct/partial/EN-adaptation classifications are provided per record. A RU-language citation alone does not make the full definition independently RU-supported.

Original https://www.fao.org/hunger/ru/ was read earlier (saved receipt) but later returned 404; slashless URL redirected to English. Public citations now use the actually read Russian FAQ. Four dimensions still use the English FAO note.

evidenceLimits.scope: UN NGO and UN-Water working definition
evidenceLimits.detail: Relevant defining passages were read from web search retrieval of the official pages. Direct NGO opening returned 403 and the first UN-Water infographic URL returned 403; this is not represented as a successful full-page fetch.

Sources establish defining concepts and explicitly recorded processes. Application examples and logic connecting cited concepts are authored teaching explanations; no blanket claim that every example sentence is independently quoted or source-verified.

The exhaustive list includes genuinely useful but unimplemented scatter, catchment, meander, hydraulic-radius and engineering diagrams; nearby illustrations are not miscounted as completing those gaps.
